external_entities.name: shopper
external_entities.description: A shopper who browses the storefront, signs in, and places orders.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Shoppers browse the storefront and place orders through the storefront API

external_entities.name: card processor
external_entities.description: A third-party card processor that settles payments and sends payment-status webhooks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our card processor is a third party.

processes.name: storefront API
processes.description: A Node service running on Cloud Run that provides the storefront, accepts shopper orders, and receives payment webhooks.
processes.source_excerpt: the storefront API, a Node service running on Cloud Run
processes.notes: Shoppers sign in with email and password and get a session cookie; MFA has not been rolled out for shopper accounts.

processes.name: order service
processes.description: A Python worker in the core network that reads and writes orders and writes completed-order receipts.
processes.source_excerpt: The order service is a Python worker in our core network
processes.notes: The database password comes from an environment variable on the worker.

data_stores.name: orders-db
data_stores.description: A PostgreSQL database containing orders, shopper addresses, and card-last-four data.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Orders, shopper addresses and card-last-four live in a PostgreSQL database (orders-db)

data_stores.name: receipt archive
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket containing receipts for completed orders.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Cloud Storage bucket we call the receipt archive

data_flows.name: place orders
data_flows.description: Shoppers browse the storefront and submit orders to the storefront API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Shoppers browse the storefront and place orders through the storefront API

data_flows.name: submit order
data_flows.description: The storefront API calls the order service when a shopper submits an order.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a shopper submits an order the storefront API calls the order service over gRPC.

data_flows.name: read and write orders
data_flows.description: The order service reads and writes orders, shopper addresses, and card-last-four data in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the order service reads and writes with a single application account that has full read/write

data_flows.name: write receipt
data_flows.description: The order service writes a receipt for every completed order to the receipt archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every completed order also gets a receipt written to a Cloud Storage bucket we call the receipt archive.
data_flows.data_description: Receipt identifying the order written and the order service that wrote it

data_flows.name: settlement webhook
data_flows.description: The card processor sends a webhook to the storefront API after settling a payment.
data_flows.source_excerpt: After they settle a payment they POST a webhook back to the storefront API to tell us the order is paid.
data_flows.notes: Webhook authentication is unresolved: "I would have to check how that callback is authenticated."

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud Run
trust_boundaries.description: The hosting zone where the storefront API runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: a Node service running on Cloud Run

trust_boundaries.name: core network
trust_boundaries.description: The core network where the order service runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The order service is a Python worker in our core network
